subject: Money
title: Legal vs Illegal
description: Learn Legal vs Illegal in one minute.

hook.text: Tax avoidance is using legal loopholes to reduce your bill. Tax evasion is hiding income. One is fine; one is prison.

buildup.text: Avoidance: contributing to a retirement account reduces taxable income. The law intends this.

discovery.text: Evasion: a restaurant owner reports half the cash receipts. The law forbids this.

twist.text: The line blurs. Aggressive avoidance—like shifting profits offshore—is legal but arguably unethical.

climax.text: Governments close loopholes; lawyers find new ones. It's a permanent cat-and-mouse game.

punchline.text: Legal and ethical aren't the same thing.

quiz.question: What's the difference between tax avoidance and evasion?
options: Avoidance is legal; evasion is illegal
Evasion is legal; avoidance is illegal
